primary_sample_definition: Primary notch-bunching sample restricts to batch managers with immutable on-chain minInterestRateChangePeriod < 604,800s (1h and 24h managers) who actually face the economic 168h cooldown fee notch, separating hardcoded 604,800s smart-contract revert walls.
